spans.text: Concerning those past humans that refused to use the newest tools,
spans.node: Technological Maximalism is Inherent To Evolution

spans.text: The opportunity cost means that while some are busy shaking their fist at the changing tides of the world, others are actualizing their vision for the future by utilizing the technology.
spans.node: Sacrifice Now To Escape Shifting Tides of Our Times

spans.text: Those that refuse to adapt to new technology will be disadvantaged,

compared to those that are early adopters and actively utilizing the technology to actualize their vision. They’re doing more than the laggards and late adopters and so they will always be able to outcompete.

Moral view's fades from existence because technology that you refuse to adopt is being adopted by others, and they are not only outproducing in terms of productivity but cultural sway in world views as well.
Etched into the geologic strata as artifacts of a bygone age.
They did not adapt and so everything they valued, withered.
Aim not to reverse the tides of change,
spans.node: Sacrifice Now To Escape Shifting Tides of Our Times

spans.text: but to bring about a world more consistent with your own view.
spans.node: On making ourselves the moral compass

spans.text: We’re always moving towards places of higher leverage where we can do more at a higher quality with less effort and so knowing that principle,
We’re not going to magically go back to a pre-AI world we’re only ever going to get more entrenched in it.
at cheaper prices, with better integration within our systems so that we can always keep doing more work at a higher quality with less.
Working in congruence with your vision to bring forth alternate technologies is the hard thing to do but it is strictly necessary depending upon your beliefs.
How often we find hitting the gas allows us to stay in motion,
affected by physical forces that we are already familiar with, and can react accordingly.
spans.node: AI as the Means for the Democratization of Intelligence

spans.text: Figure out what you wish to champion and use the tools to champion your cause.
